candidates: unfinished_utterance: The user has started meaningful speech but has not finished the sentence or thought. A required object, value or following clause is still absent.
stop_request: The user explicitly commands the currently busy assistant to stop now, correct its ongoing work, or immediately switch tasks.
non_speech: The input is only an ASR noise/silence marker or a standalone hesitation sound with no question to answer.
complete_utterance: The user has finished expressing a request, question, fact, or answer. The meaning is complete in context, even with very few words.
